'''Systems Operations''' was an office within the [[Operations (Alliance Intelligence)/Legends|Operations]] department of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Headed by a [[Case officer/Legends|case officer]] stationed at [[Sector Headquarters]], they were immobile intelligence networks based in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. The [[cell network]] was populated by natives of the system or [[Planet/Legends|planet]], recruited by either the Case Officer on on-site [[operative]]s. Once in place, the network was left to run itself without outside interference from Alliance Intelligence unless the system or planet was vital to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Networks varied in size and competency, depending on the system, which resulted in varying levels of quality in gathered intelligence. Each case officer was usually a retired [[23er]], constantly on guard for Imperial infiltration attempts and ready to close the network at a moment's notice.<ref name="RASB" />

Systems Operations operatives commonly authored the [[SecuriDex]]s issued by [[Analysis (Alliance Intelligence)|Analysis]] that detailed potential threats to the Alliance.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
